```{r,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
WL_seu <- qread("/fs/ess/PAS2148/huchen/fibroblasts_data/WL_fibroblasts.qs")
WL_seu$Condition <- factor(
  WL_seu$Condition,
  levels = 
    c('Aged control', 'IPF upper lobe', 'IPF lower lobe'))

WL_seu$Protocol_Passage_Condition <- paste0('Lung Tissue ', WL_seu$Condition)
WL_seu$Protocol_Passage_Condition <- factor(
  WL_seu$Protocol_Passage_Condition,
  levels = 
    c('Lung Tissue Aged control', 'Lung Tissue IPF upper lobe', 'Lung Tissue IPF lower lobe'))

Cultured_seu <- qread("/fs/ess/PAS2148/huchen/fibroblasts_data/Cultured_fibroblasts.qs")
Cultured_seu$Protocol <- factor(
  Cultured_seu$Protocol,
  levels = 
    c('WLCS', 'Negative Fraction', 'Outgrowth'))
Cultured_seu$Passage <- factor(
  Cultured_seu$Passage,
  levels = 
    c('Initial', 'Final'))
Cultured_seu$annotation <- factor(Cultured_seu$annotation,
                                  levels = c(
                                    'Alveolar 1', 'Alveolar 2', 'Adventitial', 'Inflammatory', 'SMCs', 'Senescence-like', 'Proliferating'
                                  ))
Cultured_seu$Protocol_Passage_Condition <- factor(
  Cultured_seu$Protocol_Passage_Condition,
  levels = c(
    'WLCS Aged control Initial', 'WLCS Aged control Final',
    'WLCS IPF upper lobe Initial', 'WLCS IPF upper lobe Final',
    'WLCS IPF lower lobe Initial', 'WLCS IPF lower lobe Final',
    'Negative Fraction Aged control Initial', 'Negative Fraction Aged control Final',
    'Negative Fraction IPF upper lobe Initial', 'Negative Fraction IPF upper lobe Final',
    'Negative Fraction IPF lower lobe Initial', 'Negative Fraction IPF lower lobe Final',
    'Outgrowth Aged control Initial', 'Outgrowth Aged control Final',
    'Outgrowth IPF upper lobe Initial', 'Outgrowth IPF upper lobe Final'
  )
)
all_condition_levels <- c("Lung Tissue Aged control",
                          'WLCS Aged control Initial', 'WLCS Aged control Final',
                          'Negative Fraction Aged control Initial', 'Negative Fraction Aged control Final',
                          'Outgrowth Aged control Initial', 'Outgrowth Aged control Final',
                          
                          "Lung Tissue IPF upper lobe", 'WLCS IPF upper lobe Initial', 'WLCS IPF upper lobe Final',
                          'Negative Fraction IPF upper lobe Initial', 'Negative Fraction IPF upper lobe Final',
                          'Outgrowth IPF upper lobe Initial', 'Outgrowth IPF upper lobe Final',
                          
                          "Lung Tissue IPF lower lobe", 'WLCS IPF lower lobe Initial', 'WLCS IPF lower lobe Final',
                          'Negative Fraction IPF lower lobe Initial', 'Negative Fraction IPF lower lobe Final')

# alveolar
plot_gene_expression_violin <- function(seu_obj1, seu_obj2, markers, annotation_type1, 
                                        annotation_type2,
                                        condition_levels = all_condition_levels,
                                        width = 16, height = 5) {
  # Check if annotation exists in each object
  has_annotation1 <- annotation_type1 %in% seu_obj1$annotation
  has_annotation2 <- annotation_type2 %in% seu_obj2$annotation
  
  # Fetch expression data conditionally for seu_obj1
  if (has_annotation1) {
    subset1 <- subset(seu_obj1, annotation == annotation_type1)
    expr1 <- FetchData(subset1, vars = c(markers, "Protocol_Passage_Condition"))
    expr1_long <- expr1 %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(markers), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expression") %>%
      mutate(dataset = "seu_obj1")
  } else {
    expr1_long <- data.frame(
      Protocol_Passage_Condition = factor(levels = condition_levels)[0],
      gene = factor(levels = markers)[0],
      expression = numeric(0),
      dataset = character(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # Fetch expression data conditionally for seu_obj2
  if (has_annotation2) {
    subset2 <- subset(seu_obj2, annotation == annotation_type2)
    expr2 <- FetchData(subset2, vars = c(markers, "Protocol_Passage_Condition"))
    expr2_long <- expr2 %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(markers), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expression") %>%
      mutate(dataset = "seu_obj2")
  } else {
    expr2_long <- data.frame(
      Protocol_Passage_Condition = factor(levels = condition_levels)[0],
      gene = factor(levels = markers)[0],
      expression = numeric(0),
      dataset = character(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # Combine data
  combined_expr_long <- bind_rows(expr1_long, expr2_long)
  
  # Set factor levels
  combined_expr_long$gene <- factor(combined_expr_long$gene, levels = markers)
  combined_expr_long$Protocol_Passage_Condition <- factor(
    combined_expr_long$Protocol_Passage_Condition,
    levels = condition_levels
  )
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(combined_expr_long, aes(x = expression, y = Protocol_Passage_Condition, fill = gene)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, adjust = 1, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    ) +
    xlab("") +
    ylab("") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = function(x) pretty_breaks(n = 3)(x)[pretty_breaks(n = 4)(x) != 0]
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(combined_expr_long$Protocol_Passage_Condition)))
  
  return(p)
}
```

 Alveolar 1
```{r, results='hide', fig.width = 14, fig.height = 5}

# Alveolar 1
alveolar_markers <- c("NPNT", "CES1", "WNT2", "TCF21", "INMT", "FIBIN",
                      "AOC3", "GPM6B", "SCN7A", "FMO2", "CYP4B1", "LIMCH1",
                      "FGFR4", "ITGA8", "RARRES2", "GPC3")
p <- plot_gene_expression_violin(
  seu_obj1 = WL_seu,
  seu_obj2 = Cultured_seu,
  markers = alveolar_markers,
  annotation_type1 = 'Alveolar',
  annotation_type2= 'Alveolar 1'
)
pdf(file.path(save.path, "wl_alveolar_cultured_alveolar1_change.pdf"), width = 14, height = 5)
print(p + theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1), "cm")))
dev.off()
p

```
